title: AssemblyRecipe
description: Declarative JSON recipe that maps request options to block IDs and placeholder values. Versioned and immutable once published. (scope plan §4.2, AD-06, G-02)

family_key.description: Document family this recipe applies to.

version.description: Monotonically increasing version number. Pinned at job start.

options.description: Schema of valid request options for this family.

rules.description: Ordered list of conditional rules. Evaluated in order; conflicts (a block both included and excluded) fail validation (AD-06).

when.description: Condition: option key-value pair(s) that trigger this rule.

include.description: Block IDs to include when the condition is met.

exclude.description: Block IDs to exclude when the condition is met.

defaults.description: Blocks kept unless a rule excludes them.

placeholder_map.description: Maps placeholder keys (^[A-Z0-9_]+$) to request field names.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Immutable once 'published'. (scope plan §4.3 AssemblyRecipe lifecycle)
